title: CheckTargetRequest
description: servtuner check-target's input: the RunSpec target to check and, optionally, the Prometheus that would collect its series. The same definitions a RunSpec uses, so a check exercises what a run would. Secrets are named, never inlined; bench reads them from --secrets-dir.

generate.description: Also send one streaming request with max_tokens 1. Absent means no: on a paid API it costs a real request.
